facts.text: On 22 May the CJP began a campaign demanding Education Minister Pradhan's resignation, centred on the NEET-UG 2026 'paper-leak' controversy; Dipke: 'It was the fault of the system that over 22 lakh students' future was impacted, it was the fault of the system that NEET students committed suicide.'

facts.text: CJP unveiled a five-point 'exam manifesto' at Savitribai Phule Pune University, including Rs 10,000 compensation per candidate when an exam is cancelled, leaked or disrupted, backup exams within 72 hours, physical evaluation of answer sheets, automatic age-limit extension, and third-party audits of online test centres.
